landing_headline: Create invoices. Directly in your browser.
landing_intro: Create invoices with regningen and download them as PDFs. No account required.
landing_local_processing: Your profile and invoice are processed locally in your browser.
landing_entry_error_description: The business profile could not be loaded from this browser. Check your browser’s storage settings and try again. You can only start an invoice after the profile has loaded successfully.
landing_thank_you: Thank you for working with us.
landing_invoice_caption: Illustrative invoice with fictional sample data
landing_profile_description: Enter your business details once: name, address, contact, tax and payment details. Your saved profile is reused for your invoices.
landing_profile_local: Your business profile stays in this browser. It is not an online account and is not synchronised between devices.
landing_positions_description: Enter the recipient and up to {limit} invoice positions with descriptions. Enter positive gross amounts in euros; the net total, VAT and gross total are calculated automatically.
landing_positions_limits: Choose one VAT rate for the entire invoice: 7% or 19%. Quantities, unit prices and mixed tax rates are not supported.
landing_pdf_description: Your details become a PDF invoice. It is created locally in your browser and downloaded directly to your device.
landing_pdf_limits: The PDF currently fits on one A4 page with limited space. Keep descriptions and details short enough to fit on the page.
landing_draft_title: Keep your draft during the session
landing_draft_description: Your entries remain available for the current tab’s session, even after reloading. You can continue working on your invoice draft.
landing_draft_limits: This is a temporary draft, not an archive of issued invoices. It is not synchronised and is not a permanent backup. Keep your downloaded PDFs yourself.
landing_draft_caption: Example of work in progress, not an invoice history
landing_backup_description: Export your last saved business profile as a JSON file to back it up or transfer it to another browser. After importing, save the profile in the open form.
landing_backup_security: The file is unencrypted and contains sensitive business, contact, tax and payment details. Store it securely.
landing_backup_limits: The backup does not include unsaved changes, drafts, PDFs or settings.
landing_backup_steps: Export the saved profile. Import the file in the other browser. Review and save the imported details.
landing_offline_description: After the initial online preparation, you can create invoices and download PDFs offline. Open regningen online first and wait for the ‘Ready offline’ message.
landing_offline_limits: Installation is optional and depends on your browser. You can also use regningen in your browser without installing it. Offline preparation does not guarantee permanent availability: the browser may remove local data.
landing_offline_step_wait: Wait for offline preparation to finish.
landing_offline_step_work: Continue working in the prepared browser without a connection.
landing_start_description: Start with your business profile. If a complete profile is already saved, you will go straight to the invoice.
